products.title: Antioxidant Dry Oil - Apiceuticals

variants.description:
PROPOWAX™ SERIES
ANTIOXIDANT • ANTIPOLLUTION

100% Clean, Sustainable, Cruelty-free Beauty
3.8 fl. oz. / 100 ml

The PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Dry Oil is a multi-purpose elixir for face, body, and hair. A luxurious blend of 7 precious oils, it delivers powerful antioxidant protection while restoring softness and radiance. Truly “dry”, it absorbs in seconds, nourishing deeply without leaving any oily residue. Your skin feels velvety soft, supple, and wrapped in Apiceuticals’ signature ultra-luxury fragrance “Woods of Arcadia”.

How to Use: FACE:

As a stand-alone facial oil: Apply a few drops to clean, damp skin for deep nourishment and antioxidant protection.
As a primer: Smooth a light layer before makeup for a radiant, even finish.
Blended with skincare: Add 1–2 drops to your daily cream or sunscreen to boost hydration and antioxidant defense.
Night repair ritual: Massage in before bed for overnight regeneration and a morning glow.

BODY:

Post-shower ritual: Massage onto damp skin after using PROPOWAX™ Shower Gel and Body Lotion. Locks in moisture, leaving skin satin-soft and perfectly dry to the touch.
Targeted care: Focus on dry areas such as elbows, knees, or décolleté for instant softness and luminosity.
Evening indulgence: Apply before bed as a full-body treatment — wake up with supple, nourished skin enveloped in fragrance.

HAIR:

For dry or damaged hair: Use as an intensive hair & scalp mask. Massage generously, leave on for 2–3 hours, then wash with PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shampoo. After rinsing, apply a few drops as a leave-on for lasting smoothness and shine.
For normal or oily hair: Use as a pre-shampoo mask. Apply to scalp and strands, leave for a few hours, then rinse. Restores balance, smoothness, and natural shine without heaviness.

details_sections.heading: Golden Ingredients
details_sections.body:
At the heart of this formula lies the synergy of 7 extraordinary oils. Together, they create an antioxidant powerhouse — defending against aggressors, slowing visible aging, locking in hydration, and leaving skin and hair irresistibly soft.

ORGANIC PROPOLIS OIL
Protective Shield

Balances and protects scalp and skin microbiome with antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory powers. Continuously infuses antioxidants during use, protecting skin and hair against oxidative stress, pollution, and UV damage.

VIRGIN MARACUJA OIL
Nutrient Boost

Rich in omega 3, 6, and vitamins A, C, E. Enhances glow and elasticity while nourishing deeply.

VIRGIN OLIVE OIL
Deep Moisture

Packed with vitamins A, D, K, E. Intensely moisturizes and restores suppleness to skin and hair.

SEA BUCKTHORN OIL
Age-Defying

Full of antioxidants, polyphenols, and vitamins A, C, E. Smooths fine lines, strengthens skin barrier, and regenerates.

GRAPE SEED OIL
Lightweight Nourishment

Absorbs instantly, leaving no residue. Rich in OPCs, among the most powerful natural antioxidants.

INCA INCHI OIL
Elasticity & Repair

Antioxidant-rich, enhances elasticity, restores damaged tissues, and prevents premature aging.

MARULA OIL
Antioxidant Powerhouse

4x the vitamin C of oranges, rich in vitamin E and fatty acids. Protects, restores, and hydrates skin and hair.

VIEW INCI LIST

details_sections.heading: FAQ
details_sections.body:
Is it free of SLS/SLES, Parabens, Silicones?

YES. Apiceuticals Clean Beauty excludes over 2,000 harmful ingredients. Strictly dermatologically tested with 0% irritation cases.

Is it suitable for all hair types?

Yes. Thanks to its lightweight dry texture and antioxidant-rich formula, it adapts to every hair need:

For dry or damaged hair, it works as an intensive scalp & strand mask — deeply repairing and replenishing when left on for a few hours, followed by shampoo and a light leave-on finish.
For normal or oily hair, it can be used as a pre-shampoo mask — nourishing without residue, balancing scalp oil, and restoring natural shine.
What makes it so unique?

PUnlike ordinary oils, it blends 7 extraordinary oils for synergistic power. And unlike others that leave residue, this is a true dry oil — absorbed in seconds, leaving skin soft and lumimous, never greasy.

How does it smell?

WOODS OF ARCADIA
Apiceuticals' Signature Scent

– an ultra-luxury, fine fragrance created for haute perfumery.

Experience a true utopia of bliss with a spicy base from vanilla and sandalwood, rising through a sensual heart of cedarwood and blackberry, and finishing with heavenly top notes of citrus and pink pepper.

This is “Woods of Arcadia” – soft, golden, and quietly powerful – an olfactory signature of elegance, nature, and timeless luxury.

Fragrance Key Pyramid Notes:
Top: Citrus Notes, Pink Pepper, Cardamom
Middle: Apricot, Blackberry, Cedarwood
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Agarwood
